title: fix(plugin-form): a line-items grid does not offer a cell the caller may read but not edit (objectui#10163)
body:
Part of #10163 — this lands the `record:line_items` half (`LineItemsPanel`). The master-detail form's own child grid (`MasterDetailForm`, `object-master-detail-form`) carries the same gap, measured below, and could not be reached here without editing `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, which this dispatch fences (objectui#9909's branch edits that file). So the card stays open for that half.

Clause-②: no — measured on this diff, not asserted: `@object-ui/plugin-form` publishes `.` only, from `index.tsx`, which does not re-export `fieldWriteGate.ts`. After a build on this head, `dist/index.d.ts` answers `applyColumnPermissions` 0 hits and `fieldWriteGate` 0 hits, with the positive control `LineItemsPanel` 2 hits in the same file — so the zeros are measured absences. `LineItemsPanel`'s props are unchanged, no authored key changes meaning, no accept set is relaxed, and the fail-open-with-no-provider posture objectui#10161 kept is unchanged.

## Step 1 — what reproduced on `main`, with the lit control

Run on unmodified `origin/main` at `62597c58`, before any source change, with the card's sibling setup: a `reporter` principal whose permission set marks `kpi_entry_line.score` `readable: true, editable: false` (plus `reviewer_note` `readable: false`), and an object-level grant that allows editing everything else on the child object.

| surface | refused column `score` | lit control `actual_value` / `indicator_name` (same grid, same rows) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `record:line_items` panel (`LineItemsPanel`) | every cell a **live, enabled** input — reproduces | enabled |
| master-detail form child grid (`MasterDetailForm`) | **enabled** — reproduces (one-off probe, not committed) | enabled |

The pin file added here, run against that unmodified tree: **2 failed / 4 passed**. The two reds are the refused-column row (`expected false to be true` on the `score` cells' `disabled`) and the unreadable-column row (3 `Reviewer note` cells rendered where 0 are expected). The four greens are the controls: add/remove lines, an unrestricted caller, no permission provider, and a `readonly` panel. So the finding is a difference inside one grid, not an absence.

⚠️ Two dispatch assumptions measured: the panel is not the only line-items grid in `plugin-form/src` — `MasterDetailForm` renders the same `LineItemsField` and consults no permission either (it does not read `schema.readonly` at all). And there was no cell-level adapter in `fieldWriteGate.ts`: handing the grid `applyFieldPermissions`' output would drop unreadable columns and lock nothing, because a grid column does not read `disabled` / `readOnly`.

## The route — the one pass, reused

- `fieldWriteGate.ts`: the loop `applyFieldPermissions` carried is now `gateByPermission`, the ONE pass that asks `checkField(object, field, 'read' | 'write')` and decides omit / keep / mark. `applyFieldPermissions` calls it with the form's mark (`readOnly` + `disabled`, plus the optional description), so `ObjectForm`, `ModalForm` and `DrawerForm` render exactly what they rendered before. The new `applyColumnPermissions` calls the SAME pass with the grid's mark. ⛔ No verdict is re-derived.
- The grid's mark is `readonlyWhen: 'true'`. A `GridColumn` has exactly one per-cell lock channel, `readonlyWhen`, which the grid evaluates per row and renders as a disabled control; a field-level refusal does not depend on the row, so the predicate that expresses it is the constant one. A refused column that declared its own narrower `readonlyWhen` is locked on every row regardless (pinned).
- `LineItemsPanel.tsx`: `usePermissions()` plus one call, `applyColumnPermissions(schema.columns, { perms, objectName: schema.childObject })`, inside the existing `gridField` memo. `allow_add` / `allow_delete` stay on `schema.readonly`, untouched.

## What changes, observably

- A column the caller may read but not edit renders its cells disabled, on loaded rows and on the entry row. Permitted columns in the same grid stay editable.
- A column the caller may not read is omitted, as the form containers already omit such a field. That is the reused pass's other half; it is pinned, not incidental.
- Adding and removing lines are unchanged.
- No permission provider mounted: byte-for-byte the grid it was — every column, every cell editable (pinned).

## Ablation — committed first, mutated, restored

Mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode, restore armed on exit and signals), on the committed head `f87c020e`: the gate wiring `columns: applyColumnPermissions(schema.columns, { perms, objectName: schema.childObject }),` replaced by `columns: schema.columns,` in `LineItemsPanel.tsx`.

- Landed on disk: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `44b47677f220` to `7b8ee94590f9`.
- Result: **3 failed / 4 passed**. The three reds are exactly the refusal rows — the refused column, the refused column under a narrower authored lock, the unreadable column — each failing on its refusal assertion; in the two lock rows the lit-control assertion above it in the same test had already passed. The four controls stayed green.
- Restore: blob after restore `44b47677f220` equals the `HEAD` blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Direction observed: turn-red, as expected. No `dist/` is involved: the pins import `./LineItemsPanel` by relative path, and the root vitest config aliases every `@object-ui/*` specifier to `src`.

## Checks on this head (`f87c020e`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/` from the repo root, through the shared verify lock: **109 files, 1051 passed, 1 skipped**, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-form^...`). The script runs `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` as well, and `--listFiles` shows the new test file in it.
- `eslint .` in `packages/plugin-form`: exit 0, 0 errors across 142 files.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check-lint-coverage`; `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the four paths answers NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **The outbound half is not touched, and no 403 is claimed.** The card grades this as an affordance defect. Three grid paths can still put a refused column on a child op, none measured against a server here: duplicating a line copies its values into a create; a lookup cell's autofill copies matching fields into sibling columns (it skips computed columns, not locked ones); and the entry row is materialised with every column set to `null`. Updates are already narrowed to dirty cells by objectui#10154.
- **A cleaner lock exists but is fenced here.** A static per-column lock read by the grid itself would avoid spelling a row-independent verdict as a constant predicate. It needs an edit under `packages/fields/src/widgets/` (fenced for this dispatch, objectui#10225) and a new member on the published `GridColumn` type. Owner of that file: none named.
- `fieldWriteGate.ts` gains two `no-explicit-any` warnings, from the same `Record` constraint the existing `applyFieldPermissions` signature already carries.
- The commit carries a model-named `Co-Authored-By` trailer; noted here rather than rewritten (history is not rewritten on this repository).
- The remaining half of #10163: route `MasterDetailForm`'s `LineItemsField` columns through `applyColumnPermissions` (the child object name is already on each detail entry): a `usePermissions()` read plus one call, once that file is free.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat; this session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`.
